item.title: Avalo Hidradenitis Suppurativa
item.description:
• Summary: Avalo advances in hidradenitis suppurativa, with a drug that also involves BioNTech, Madrigal, and Johnson & Johnson Duet in the landscape.
  • MoAs: Not specified; likely an immunomodulator.
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive

item.title: J&J Dual Antibody IBD Phase 3
item.description:
• Summary: Johnson & Johnson is advancing its investigational dual antibody therapy for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) into Phase 3 trials, despite disappointing mid-stage results. The decision underscores J&J's confidence in the mechanism, which simultaneously targets two distinct inflammatory pathways to improve outcomes in Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
  • MoAs: Dual antibody therapy: neutralizes two key cytokines (e.g., IL-23 and TNF-α or IL-1β) to reduce intestinal inflammation in IBD.
  • Sources: BioSpace
